System and method for artificial intelligence/machine learning positioningTechnical Field

The present disclosure relates generally to wireless communications, including but not limited to systems and methods for artificial intelligence/machine learning positioning.

Background

The standardization organization third generation partnership project (3 GPP) is currently making a new radio interface called a 5G new air interface (5G NR) and specifications for the next generation packet core network (NG-CN or NGC). The 5G NR will have three main components, a 5G access network (5G-AN), a 5G core network (5 GC) and a User Equipment (UE). In order to facilitate the implementation of different data services and requirements, the elements of 5GC (also referred to as network functions) have been simplified, some of which are software-based, and some of which are hardware-based, so that they can be adjusted as required. In general, one or more basic functions of an Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) process may be supported. Basic functions may include data collection, AI/ML model training, AI/ML model reasoning, model updating, model selection, and so forth.

Disclosure of Invention

The example embodiments disclosed herein are directed to solving problems associated with one or more of the problems set forth in the prior art, and to providing additional features that will become apparent when reference is made to the following detailed description taken in conjunction with the accompanying drawings. According to various embodiments, example systems, methods, apparatus, and computer program products are disclosed herein. However, it should be understood that these embodiments are presented by way of example and not limitation, and that various modifications of the disclosed embodiments may be made while remaining within the scope of the disclosure, as will be apparent to those of ordinary skill in the art from reading the disclosure.

At least one aspect relates to the following systems, methods, apparatus, or computer readable media. The wireless communication method may include a first wireless communication entity (e.g., UE 104) receiving positioning related information from a second wireless communication entity or a third wireless communication entity. The second wireless communication entity is a User Equipment (UE) or a positioning reference unit (Positioning Reference Unit, PRU). The positioning related information may include capabilities of the second wireless communication entity node for artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) positioning. The capabilities may include one or more { N, T } sets and/or one or more { N2, T2} sets. The capability may include one or more of a maximum number of DL-PRS resource sets per positioning frequency layer (TRP) supported by the second wireless communication entity, a maximum number of TRPs for all positioning frequency layers of AI/ML positioning, a maximum number of supported positioning frequency layers for AI/ML positioning, a maximum number of DL-PRS resources per DL-PRS resource set for AI/ML positioning, a maximum number of DL-PRS resources per positioning frequency layer supported by the second wireless communication entity for AI/ML positioning.

In some embodiments, the capability may include whether the second wireless communication entity supports reporting both AI/ML location results and location results of other manners of location. This capability may include the ability of the second wireless communication entity to derive AI/ML inference quality/confidence level/model inference delay (Q) for its position inference and/or new measurements and/or enhancements to existing measurements using N Q PRS in a combination of { N Q, Q }. The capability may include one or more of a processing speed of the second wireless communication entity, a maximum capacity, a ratio of remaining space to maximum capacity, remaining available time or space for receiving PRS and/or collecting a data set, or a timestamp of a current state, or a model inference delay, or a model ID, or a function.

In some embodiments, the capability may include an occupancy state and a processing capacity of one or more processing units of the second wireless communication entity. The occupancy status and processing capacity may include at least one of an idle/busy indicator for each of the one or more processing units, a processing capability for each of the one or more processing units, an indicator for indicating whether any of the one or more processing units is idle, reservation information for each of the one or more processing units, a number of subsets in the one or more processing units that are idle, a number of subsets in the one or more processing units that are busy, a total number of the one or more processing units, an association between a number of the one or more processing units, a processing capability, and a processing time, or an association between a number of the one or more processing units, a processing capability, and a processing quality.

In some embodiments, N Q may indicate the duration of the DL-PRS symbol. N Q may indicate the size of the data set for the positioning reference signal. N Q may indicate the size of each data set and the number of data sets for the positioning reference signal. Q represents at least one of a quality value and a quality resolution, or a confidence value and a confidence value resolution, or a delay requirement of model reasoning. Q represents at least one of a confidence level of Line of Sight (LOS)/Non-Line of Sight (NLOS) recognition, an inference quality for time-series inference, or an inference quality for angle inference.

In some embodiments, N and/or N2 may indicate a duration of a downlink positioning reference signal (Downlink Positioning REFERENCE SIGNAL, DL-PRS) symbol, a duration of N PRS symbols that can be processed by the second wireless communication entity per T milliseconds (ms), and/or a duration of N2 PRS symbols that can be processed by the second wireless communication entity within T2 ms. N and/or N2 may indicate a size of a data set for positioning reference signals, a size of N PRS symbols that can be processed by the second wireless communication entity per T milliseconds (ms), and/or a size of N2 PRS symbols that can be processed by the second wireless communication entity within T2 ms.

In some embodiments, N and/or N2 may also indicate a size of each data set and a number of data sets for positioning reference signals, a set of N PRS symbols that can be processed per T milliseconds (ms) by the second wireless communication entity, and/or a set of N2 PRS symbols that can be processed by the second wireless communication entity within T2 ms. The second or third wireless communication entity may be configured to report one or more { N, T } sets for PRS processing for AI/ML positioning and other positioning manners. The second or third wireless communication entity may be configured to report one or more { N2, T2} sets for PRS processing for AI/ML positioning and other positioning manners. The second or third wireless communication entity may be configured to report an indicator indicating one or more { N, T } sets and/or one or more { N2, T2} sets for one of PRS processing for AI/ML positioning only, PRS processing for other positioning modes, or PRS processing for both AI/ML positioning and other positioning modes.

In some embodiments, the wireless communication method may include the first wireless communication entity requesting the second wireless communication entity to report AI/ML location results and location results of other manners of location. The preconditions for AI/ML assisted positioning may include feature sets for Multi-Round Trip Time (Multi-RTT) and Downlink TIME DIFFERENCE of Arrival Time difference (DL-TDOA). The preconditions for AI/ML assisted positioning may include a feature set for downlink departure angle (Downlink Angle of Departure, DL-AOD) positioning. The wireless communication method may include the first wireless communication entity transmitting a message for requesting capability related information to the second wireless communication entity. The wireless communication method may include the first wireless communication entity sending a message requesting the second wireless communication entity to reserve an occupancy state for one or more processing units.

In some embodiments, the message may include at least one of a processing speed of the second wireless communication entity, a maximum capacity, a ratio of remaining space to maximum capacity, a remaining available time or space for receiving PRS and/or collecting a data set, or a timestamp of a current state, or a model inference delay, or a model ID, or a functionality, or periodicity and offset of reporting capability related information by the second wireless communication entity, a time for reporting capability related information by the second wireless communication entity, or a response time for reporting capability related information by the second wireless communication entity. The message may comprise at least one of a start time and/or an end time, a duration of the reservation, a number of reserved processing units, an identification of the reserved processing units, a periodicity of the reservation period.

In some embodiments, the wireless communication method may include the first wireless communication entity transmitting an AI/ML location configuration. The AI/ML location configuration may include at least one of a list of cell IDs or range coordinates. The AI/ML-related information may include a mapping relationship between the model ID and a plurality of standards. The criteria may include at least one of a ratio between a number of TRPs with LOS paths and a total number of TRPs, a number of TRPs with LOS paths, a cell ID, a value and a range of reference signal received Power (REFERENCE SIGNAL RECEIVED Power, RSRP), a granularity of timing measurements, a quality of timing values, an initial phase offset of a transmitter, a number of samples per input, a granularity of samples per input, a requirement of AI/ML Positioning, a Positioning reference signal (Positioning REFERENCE SIGNAL, PRS), and/or a configuration of a Sounding reference signal (Sounding REFERENCE SIGNAL, SRS). The AI/ML location configuration may also include a time window for enabling AI/ML location procedures. The IE for AI/ML location may include at least one of a triggered report requesting AI/ML location, a periodic report requesting AI/ML location, a quality of service for AI/ML location, a location information type for AI/ML location.

In some embodiments, the AI/ML positioning configuration can further include at least one of an AI/ML reference signal, an RSRP threshold, or an LOS or NLOS ratio threshold. The wireless communication method may include the first wireless communication entity transmitting a message including assistance data for AI/ML positioning. The assistance data may include dedicated PRSs for AI/ML positioning and/or configurations of dedicated PRSs. The assistance data may include at least one of a subset of DL-PRS resource priorities for AI/ML positioning, a model ID, beam information of DL-PRS for AI/ML positioning, a TRP ID, a positioning frequency layer for AI/ML positioning.

In some embodiments, the wireless communication method may include the first wireless communication entity configuring the requested SRS transmission characteristic for the third wireless communication entity. The requested SRS transmission characteristics may include SRS configuration for AI/ML positioning. The SRS configuration may include at least one of a UL-SRS resource priority subset for AI/ML positioning, a model ID, beam information for UL-SRS for AI/ML positioning, a UE ID. The wireless communication method may include the first wireless communication entity receiving a report including a tag from the second wireless communication entity. The tag may include at least one of a UE location, a UE ID, or a time stamp, start time, and/or duration indicating a location validity. The wireless communication method may include the first wireless communication entity receiving a report including a measurement result from the third wireless communication entity, the measurement result may include at least one of a CIR/PDP/DP, a UE ID, or a timestamp.

In some embodiments, the wireless communication method may include the first wireless communication entity sending a requirement or configuration for AI/ML positioning to the second and/or third wireless communication entity. The requirements or configurations may include requirements for data set reporting. The requirements of the dataset reporting may include at least one of periodicity of each report, data type requirements, data size requirements for each dimension, size of the dataset, quality of the data tag required, confidence level of the data tag required, uncertainty threshold of the timing and/or angle measurements required, timestamp of the generated data, configuration requirements of the dataset, source of the data tag, indicated time and/or time difference threshold.

In some embodiments, the wireless communication method may include the first wireless communication entity receiving a report of AI/ML location from the second and/or third wireless communication entity. The report may include a data set report, wherein the data set report may include at least one of a data type, a data size for each dimension, a size of the data set, a quality of the data tag, a confidence level of the data tag, an indicator of the data tag, a timestamp of the generated data, a source of the data tag, an ID of the reporting party, a size of the data set still needed.

In some embodiments, the wireless communication method may include the first wireless communication entity receiving an inference result or an AI/ML location result from the second or third wireless communication entity. The inference results or AI/ML location results may include at least one of LOS/NLOS identification results, timing measurements, or angle measurements, or a location of the second wireless communication entity. The inference results or AI/ML location results may include confidence levels, and/or model inference delays, and/or quality of measurement/inference. The requirements or configurations may include reference information for measurement reporting. The requirements or configurations may include configurations for model updates. The configuration for model updating may include at least one of expected update time, expected update period and offset, latest model, timestamp of latest model, size of data set of each update training, duration of PRS/SRS of each update training, model ID and/or functionality, positioning scenario, UE ID, PRU ID, TRP ID. The report may include a model report, wherein the model report may include at least one of an updated model, a feature and/or size of a dataset used to train the model, a duration of a PRS/SRS used to train the model, a timestamp of the report or updated model, a model ID and/or function, a positioning scenario, a UE ID, a PRU ID, a TRP ID. The reference information may include at least one of reference PRS/SRS resources and/or a set of resources for AI/ML positioning, reference TRP/UE for AI/ML positioning.

In some embodiments, the wireless communication method may include the first wireless communication entity sending a message to the second or third wireless communication entity including configuration information for one or more time windows configured for AI/ML positioning. Each of the one or more time windows is defined based on at least one of a start time of the time window, a duration of the time window, a periodicity of the time window, a PRS resource set ID, an SRS resource set ID, a PRS resource ID, an SRS resource ID, or a TRP ID.

In some embodiments, the configuration of the time window includes one or more of a start time, a duration of the time window, a periodicity of the time window.

The Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model (referred to herein as the "open systems interconnection model") is a concept and logical layout that defines network communications used by systems (e.g., wireless communication devices, wireless communication nodes) that can interconnect and communicate with other systems. The model is divided into seven sub-components or layers, each of which represents a collection of concepts that provide services to the upper and lower layers thereof. The OSI model also defines a logical network and effectively describes computer data packet transmission by using different layer protocols. The OSI model may also be referred to as a seven layer OSI model or a seven layer model. In some embodiments, the first layer may be a physical layer. In some embodiments, the second layer may be a Medium Access Control (MAC) layer. In some embodiments, the third layer may be a Radio Link Control (RLC) layer. In some embodiments, the fourth layer may be a Packet Data Convergence Protocol (PDCP) layer. In some embodiments, the fifth layer may be a Radio Resource Control (RRC) layer. In some embodiments, the sixth layer may be a non-access stratum (NAS) layer or an Internet Protocol (IP) layer, and the seventh layer is the other layer.

System and method for artificial intelligence/machine learning positioning

Example 1 AI/ML positioning capability of UE

During the current positioning procedure, the UE may report the capability of the DL-PRS processing procedure, and the information element (Information Element, IE) NR-DL-PRS-ProcessingCapability defines the general DL-PRS processing capability. The UE may report a combination of { N, T } indicating the duration of the DL-PRS symbol, where N is in milliseconds, the UE may process every T milliseconds, and/or report a combination of { N2, T2} indicating the duration of the DL-PRS symbol, where N2 is in milliseconds, the UE may process within T2 milliseconds. With the UE capability report, the network node may be aware of the processing capabilities of the UE 104 and may determine the corresponding measurement requirements.

In the AI/ML positioning procedure, if AI/ML training and/or reasoning phases are performed at the UE side, the UE may report processing capabilities corresponding to the training and/or reasoning. Without the UE capability report, the network 100 may have difficulty evaluating AI/ML training and/or reasoning timelines, required duration, or required positioning quality. Furthermore, the UE may report the processing power of AI/ML positioning.

Fig. 3 shows an example of a process for channel estimation and AI/ML training or reasoning. The total processing time required may include a duration of 2 phases. The first phase may include channel estimation (e.g., phase 1) and the second phase may include AI/ML training or inference time (e.g., phase 2). The output of the channel estimation may be the channel impulse response (Channel Impulse Response, CIR) or the power Delay Profile (Power Delay Profile, PDP) or the Delay Profile (DP), and the CIR/PDP/DP may be the input of AI/ML training and reasoning. The UE may report UE processing capabilities including one or more { N, T } and/or { N2, T2} sets of one or more AI/ML models. The UE may report different { N, T } and/or { N2, T2} sets to the direct AI/ML location model and the AI/ML assisted location model.

The processing power reported by the UE may be applicable to the channel estimation, and/or AI/ML training or reasoning, and/or the total processing power of the channel estimation and AI/ML training and AI/ML reasoning. The processing capability may include a combination of { N, T } indicating PRS durations or data sets N that the UE may process every T milliseconds, and/or a combination of { N2, T2} indicating PRS durations or data sets N2 that the UE may process within T2 milliseconds.

N and/or N2 may indicate the size of each data set and the number of data sets. The UE may indicate a characteristic of the data set description size of each list (e.g., the characteristic includes one or more of a number of TRPs, a number of antenna port pairs, a number of samples per CIR/PDP/DP, or a number of PRS resources, etc.). N and/or N2 may include one or more candidates. The first candidate may be a list where N and N2 may be { M, [ X, Y, Z, U ] } combinations, which may indicate that the UE is capable of processing M data sets of size [ X, Y, Z, U ]. For ease of description, X may indicate the number of TRPs, Y may be the number of antenna port pairs, Z may be the number of samples per CIR/PDP/DP, and U may be the number of PRS resources. For example, the format of N and/or N2 may be { M1, [ X1, Y1, Z1, U1] }, { M2, [ X2, Y2, Z2, U2] }, or { M3, [ X3, Y3, Z3, U2] ]. The second candidate may be a list where N and/or N2 may be { M, V } combinations. The second candidate may indicate that the UE may process M data sets with certain features, where V may be any one or more of the four-dimensional features. The V dimension of each list may be the same or different. For example, the format of N and/or N2 may be { M1, [ X1, Y1, Z1] }, { M2, [ X2, Y2, Z2] }, or { M3, [ X3, Y3, Z3] }. In another example, the format of N and/or N2 may be { M1, [ U1] }, { M2, [ U2] }. In another example, the format of N and/or N2 may be { M1, [ U1] }, { M2, [ X2, U2] }.

The third candidate may be a list where N and/or N2 may be { M, W } combinations. The third candidate may indicate that the UE may process M data sets of size W. For ease of description, W may indicate the product of [ X, Y, Z, U ], i.e., w=x×y×z×u. For example, the format of N and/or N2 is { M1, W1} or { M2, W2}. The fourth candidate may be a list where N and/or N2 may be { M, W } combinations. The fourth candidate may indicate that the UE may process M data sets of size W. For ease of description, W may indicate a product of any one or more of the four-dimensional features (e.g., w=z or w=z×u). A fifth candidate may be that N and/or N2 may indicate the size of the data set that the UE may process every T milliseconds and/or that the UE may process within T2 milliseconds. The unit of data set size may be bytes, megabytes, gigabytes, or the like. Example 5 use of Federal learning in positioning

Federal learning can be defined as an ML technique that trains AI/ML models on multiple, decentralized edge nodes (e.g., UE, gNB), each node using local data samples for local model training. This technique requires multiple interactions of the model, but does not require the exchange of local data samples. In AI/ML positioning, the UE/PRU/gNB can generate training data based on the measurement results of the UE/PRU/GNB. An AI/ML model can be implemented in these entities that provides the basic framework required to implement federal learning. However, current signaling does not support achieving federal learning for positioning purposes.

FIG. 6 illustrates an example of a federal learning process for positioning. Each participant (e.g., PRU) may download the latest model from a server (e.g., LMF). Each participant may use the local data training model to encrypt the gradient and upload the gradient to the server. The server may aggregate the gradients for each user to update the model parameters. The server may return the updated model to all participants. Each participant may update the model.

In a general positioning model, the server may be an LMF and the participants of the LMF may be UEs, PRUs and/or TRPs. The server may be a gNB, and the participants of the gNB may be UEs, PRUs, and/or other gnbs. For AI/ML positioning at the UE side, the server may be the UE and the participants of the UE may be PRUs, TRPs, and/or other UEs. The server (e.g., LMF, gNB, or UE) may send the latest AI/ML model and/or configuration information to the participants (e.g., UE, PRU, and/or gNB). The configuration information may include one or more elements. In some settings, the configuration may be associated with a model ID and/or functionality.

The model report may include an updated model, features and/or sizes of a dataset that trains the model, a duration of PRS/SRS that trains the model, a timestamp that reports or updates the model, a model ID and/or model function, and a positioning scenario.
